personal.name: Personal site
personal.intro: Give your name a home online.
personal.description: For an individual who wants an official presence, with or without a business.
personal.scope: Start with a focused page introducing you, your story and how to reach you.
personal.demoHeadline: A little about me. A place for my work.
personal.demoSubline: Stories, photographs and the things I’m making.

professional.name: Professional site
professional.intro: Let your work speak for you.
professional.description: For freelancers, consultants, creators, artists and public-facing professionals.
professional.scope: Start with your introduction, selected work, relevant services and one clear contact path.
professional.demoHeadline: Considered work. A clear point of view.
professional.demoSubline: Independent design, direction and visual storytelling.

business.name: Business site
business.description: For sellers, salons, restaurants and businesses that want their own customer destination.
business.scope: Start with what you offer, why it matters, your contact details and the next customer action.
business.demoSubline: Objects, flowers and a little room to slow down.

company.name: Company site
company.intro: A clear home for a bigger story.
company.description: For companies and organizations presenting their purpose, people, services and projects.
company.scope: Start with a clear company overview. Add separate pages only where the content and audience need them.
company.demoHeadline: Progress starts with a clear direction.
company.demoSubline: People, ideas and practical work moving together.

booking.name: Appointment booking
booking.note: SENZ will confirm booking availability and scope before including it.

catalog.name: Managed digital catalog
catalog.note: A simple product showcase may be enough. Catalog management is scoped separately.

order.name: Ordering
order.note: Ordering and online payment need a separate feasibility review; they are not included or available for instant activation.

updates.name: Regular updates
updates.note: Agree the update workflow and any ongoing content service in your quote.
